what: The section is pinned to the screen and scroll winds the product video up to a hold frame (72/154). For each callout a thin line stretches from 58px and transparent to 8.06vw while the title line rises, and 1.2 steps later the description lines rise from line masks .2 step apart. After all three are lit the marker turns on, rests 5 steps, then the descriptions switch off all at once and the video winds to the end (everything is tied directly to scroll)

options.pause: Video pause point (ratio of total length), default 72/154
options.hold: Rest slot after all lit, default 5
options.duration: Seconds to use when the video length can’t be read, default 6
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel that sticks to the screen (the Section itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=video]: Scrub video (optional) — the shorter the keyframe interval (source g 5), the smoother
options.[data-fx-part=callout]: One description item (required, repeatable) — contains line, title, row
options.[data-fx-part=line] · [data-fx-part=titl: Extending line · title line · description line (each [data-fx-part=mask] inside the mask)

use: LidDescription line

from.where: index.js Section 3 .pv-s3 — original home-scroll initScrollTriggersDesktop: section3 video currentTime in 4 steps → duration×72/154, three callout lines (width 8.0555vw · title · line delay 1.2 stagger .2), icons stagger .1, turns off after delay 5, video in 12 steps

note: The original splits lines with SplitText — for this part, the user places a row per line (long Korean lines are broken in advance). To turn off pinning on phones, the user sets data-fx only at 1024 and above
